EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (A) - PROVINCIAL COUNCILS
NORTH CENTRAL PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Hon. Governor of North Central Provincial Council

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 32(a) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987, I, MarappuligeJayasinghe, the Governor of the North Central Province do hereby notify that the officers, names mentioned below havebeen appointed for the posts North Central Provincial Council Services.
1. Mr. H. M. Thilaka Bandara, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Secretary of
the Chief Ministry of North Central Province with effect from 2018.07.11 until further an order is made.
2. Mr. W. A. R. Wimalasiri, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service (retired) as the
Secretary of the Provincial Public Service Commission of North Central Province for 03 months with effectfrom 2018.12.11 to 2019.03.10 on contract basic.
3. Mr. R. A. S. Jayathilake, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the
Secretary (Personnel and Training) of the Chief Ministry of North Central Province in addition to the duties ofthe permanent post with effect from 2018.07.06 to 2018.10.22 .
4. Mrs. D. M. C. K. Chandradasa, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Administrative Service (Retired) as the Deputy
Secretary (Admin.) of the Chief Ministry of North Central Province for three months with effect from2018.10.12 untill 2019.01.11 on contract basic.
5. Mrs. G. K. S. Chandralatha, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Administrative Service as the Deputy Secretary
(Personnel and Training) of the Chief Ministry of North Central Province with effect from 2018.10.23 untillfurther order is made.
6. Mr. P. K. Jayalath, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the the Secretary of the
Ministry of Co-operative of North Central Provincial Council with effect from 2018.11.21 to 2018.12.27 inaddition to the duties of his permanent post.

9. Mr. R. M. N. S. Rathnayake, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Accounting Service as the Director (Finance and

10. Mr. R. M. N. S. Rathnayake, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Accounting Service in addition to the duties of his
permanent post for acting as the Director (Accounts and Payment) of the treasury of the North CentralProvince with effect from 2018.10.18 untill further notice is made.
11. Mr. J. K. U. A. Jayalath, Officer in Special Grade of Sri Lanka Educational Service for acting as the Director of
Education the North Central Province in addition to the duties of his permanent post with effect from 2018.10.18untill further notice is made.
12. Mr. K. M. U. M. Amarasinghe, Officer in Grade I of Sri Lanka Animal Product and Health Service as the
Provincial Director in the Department of Animal Products and Health of the North Central Province witheffect from 2018.09.27 untill further notice is made.
13. Mr. R. S. Samaranayaka, Officer in Grade I of Inland Revenue Service (Retired) for acting as the Commissioner of
Provincial Revenue of the North Central Province on contract basic with effect from 2018.09.11 untill further noticeis made.
14. Mrs. T. A. Pathirage, Officer Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the Commissioner of Motor
Traffic of the North Central Province in addition to the duties of her permanent post with effect from 2018.09.11untill further notice is made.
15. Mrs. A. M. V. S. Jayawardana, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service to perform duties of the
post of Director, Industrial Development, North Central Province with effect from 2018.09.20 untill furthernotice is made.
16. Mr. E. G. U. Rajapakasha, Officer in Grade III of Sri Lanka Administrative Service for acting as the Commissioner
of Probation and child care Services of the North Central Province with effect from 2018.09.20.
